steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each effect and cost is matched to its source. A risk with no mitigation is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 effects or risks lack a basis

findings.title: Risk with no mitigation
findings.fix: Name a mitigation and its owner

findings.title: Effect with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis for the effect

findings.title: Cost line with no estimate source

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] risk-training.md:12  Risk with no mitigation.
       Fix: Name a mitigation and its owner.
[medium] benefit-scrap.md:19  Effect with no basis.
       Fix: Give the basis for the effect.
[medium] cost-install.csv:26  Cost line with no estimate source.

Not checked: The actual effect.
pros: Checks an effect with no basis, a cost line with no estimate source, and a risk with no mitigation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-line-change-proposal skill on the records for this review.
